body_markdown:
Rock star Bret Michaels has been forced to cancel the remaining dates of his solo tour after undergoing surgery for a painful kidney stone condition.


The 63-year-old singer, best known as the frontman of the American rock band Poison, had hoped to return to performing quickly after treatment. However, doctors have advised him to take several months away from the road to allow his body to recover properly.


Michaels recently made his first attempt to return to the stage following surgery. He performed on Friday, August 21, but medical professionals have now determined that continuing with a demanding touring schedule would not be in his best interests.


The decision means that several upcoming performances on his Bret Michaels Live and Amplified tour will no longer go ahead as planned.


## Bret Michaels Underwent Surgery After Severe Pain


Michaels' health problems became particularly difficult earlier this summer when he performed several live shows despite experiencing intense pain caused by a kidney stone.


The singer had previously revealed that he was dealing with significant discomfort while continuing his professional commitments. After completing a third show in Washington, he was taken to hospital for further treatment.


Doctors subsequently performed surgery to remove the kidney stone and inserted a ureteral stent as part of his treatment.


Following the procedure, Michaels told fans that the operation had been completed and that he was recovering from the procedure. He also indicated that he was doing everything possible to regain his strength.


Despite the difficult circumstances, the musician was determined to return to the stage. His first performance after surgery took place on August 21.


However, his medical team believes that attempting to continue touring at this point could place unnecessary strain on his recovery.


## Doctors Recommend Several Months of Rest


In a statement shared through Michaels' social media account, his medical team explained that the singer would be taken off the road temporarily.


The doctors said Michaels needs a period of rest and a slower recovery, particularly because of the challenging summer conditions.


Heat and humidity can make performing physically demanding, and his doctors also raised concerns about the potential impact of the conditions on his blood sugar levels.


Their recommendation is for Michaels to step away from live performances for the next several months while he concentrates on getting back to full health.


The decision is a significant setback for a performer who has spent much of his career on stage. Michaels has nevertheless made it clear that he understands the importance of following medical advice.


## Tour Dates Cancelled


Michaels had been scheduled to perform at several locations as part of his Bret Michaels Live and Amplified tour.


The cancelled performances included dates in Texas, Ohio, Vancouver and Minnesota. He was also forced to withdraw from the Mountain Music Festival in Tennessee.


For fans who were looking forward to seeing the singer perform live, the cancellations will undoubtedly be disappointing. However, Michaels has suggested that he hopes to return to the festival in a future year.


He has said he would like to appear at the Mountain Music Festival in either 2027 or 2028 and promised to deliver what he described as the best show ever.


The comments underline Michaels' determination to return to music once his health allows him to do so.


## 'My Energy and My Soul Really Want to Play Music'


Michaels has been open with fans about the difficulties he has experienced during his recent health problems.


In a message shared on Monday, August 24, he thanked his family, friends, fans and professional colleagues for their support.


The singer said the encouragement he received gave him the strength to keep going during what he described as a series of medical challenges.


Michaels also acknowledged that he had initially believed he would be able to complete his scheduled performances despite the recent health problems.


His comments reflect the determination that has become an important part of his public image throughout his career. Rather than focusing solely on the cancellations, he has repeatedly stressed his desire to recover and eventually return to the stage.


He is now working closely with doctors and physical therapists as he adjusts to his treatment and medication.


The recovery process is also being affected by the summer heat across parts of the United States, which has added another consideration for his medical team.


Michaels has made it clear that, if the decision were entirely his, he would already be preparing to perform again. For now, however, his health has to take priority.


## A Career Built Around Live Performance


Bret Michaels has been a prominent figure in rock music for decades.


As the lead singer of Poison, he became associated with some of the biggest rock hits of the 1980s and early 1990s. Songs including "Every Rose Has Its Thorn" and "Talk Dirty to Me" helped establish the band as one of the defining acts of the glam metal era.


Michaels later developed a successful solo career and became a familiar television personality as well.


Live performance has remained an important part of his career, making the current cancellation particularly significant.


The singer's willingness to return to the stage shortly after surgery demonstrates how strongly he remains connected to performing. At the same time, the advice from his doctors suggests that recovery cannot be rushed.


For now, fans will have to wait for further updates about his condition and his plans to return to touring.


## Other Recent Changes to Michaels' Schedule


The latest tour cancellation comes after another major change to Michaels' performance schedule earlier this summer.


He withdrew from Donald Trump's Freedom 250 celebration at the Great American State Fair, explaining that the event had developed into something more divisive than he had originally understood when his team was approached.


Michaels said the opportunity had initially been presented to his team as a celebration of the United States through music, with a focus on honouring veterans, military personnel, first responders, teachers and working Americans.


He later described his decision to withdraw as difficult.


The development was separate from his current medical situation, but it has contributed to a summer filled with unexpected changes to his professional plans.


## What's Next for Bret Michaels?


For now, Michaels' priority appears to be recovery rather than returning immediately to the stage.


The singer is working with his medical team and physical therapists while monitoring his progress. There is currently no indication that he intends to abandon performing permanently.


Instead, the available information suggests that he wants to take the necessary time to recover before returning to the demanding schedule associated with touring.


Michaels has continued to express optimism about getting back to full strength and reconnecting with his fans.


His story also highlights the physical demands placed on performers who spend long periods travelling and performing live. Even an experienced musician can face serious health challenges that make it impossible to maintain a normal touring schedule.


For Michaels, the message to fans is one of patience. Although he would clearly prefer to be back on stage, his doctors believe that several months of recovery are necessary.


The rock singer's determination to return remains strong, but for the moment, the focus is on healing.


Fans can expect further updates as Michaels progresses through his recovery and begins planning his eventual return to live music.


### Source


**The Independent** , August 25, 2026.
